body:
## FA-007 / ZEUS-2dd28a919f60 revision 1 — Refs #8

### Defect (upstream, agreed in cross-review)
Guardian `ledger_seal.verify` downgraded a sealed-prefix rewrite from TAMPER to RESEAL_REQUIRED as soon as a new `.compacted` sidecar existed, without verifying that file's compaction relation; the CLI returned 0 for UNSEALED and the watchdog ignored verification exceptions (`same_tamper_plus_new_sidecar` probe). Consensus: prove the before/after relation of compaction and never collapse unknown into healthy.

### Zeus checked
SDD and ticket-lifecycle journals are hash-chained and fail closed; Redis stream compaction only trims below the pending/undelivered boundary; deployment health reports `unknown` explicitly. **Artifact collection did not**: `ArtifactMaintenance.collect` transitively marks every `sha256:` reference, but a referenced file that was already missing was skipped with `continue` and left no trace in the result — lost evidence folded into a healthy-looking collection, while a corrupted file aborted (asymmetric).

### Change
- `adapters/maintenance.py`: collect missing references; result gains `missing_references`, `missing_reference_sample` (≤20) and `integrity: complete | missing_references`; `apply` records one content-addressed `artifact.reference_missing` event per lost reference. Orphan reclamation continues; corrupted references still abort before any deletion.
- `docs/contracts.md`: `INV-RESOURCE-001` sentences on missing/corrupted references and on appended records never softening a chain break.
- `docs/zeus/implementation/integrity-unknown-001/README.md`: integrity-path table and evidence.

### Verification
| | Result |
|---|---|
| `test_missing_referenced_evidence_is_reported_not_folded_into_a_healthy_result`: preview and apply report the lost ref, orphan reclaimed, kept ref retained, exactly one durable event even across re-runs, clean store reports `complete` | pass |
| `test_corrupted_referenced_evidence_aborts_collection_before_any_deletion` | pass |
| `tests/test_sdd.py::test_appended_sidecar_event_never_softens_a_journal_break` on real PostgreSQL (isolated schema): rewritten event 1 + well-formed "compaction_marker" continuation + updated head → still `journal gap or corruption`, both records retained | pass |
| Negative control: revert `maintenance.py` to `origin/main` | the missing-reference test fails |
| Windows full `uv run pytest -q` (Python 3.12.14, PG cases skipped) / `ruff check` | 919 passed, 306 skipped / clean |
| Linux path | this PR's ubuntu CI matrix |

### Not claimed
No automatic recovery of lost references (the event and result fields surface them; disposition is the operator's). Showing `maintenance.latest.integrity` in the monitor UI is separate work. Issue closure follows the ledger acceptance path (#30) and is a separate step after this PR; the GitHub issue stays OPEN until that acceptance.

title: fix: report missing referenced artifacts instead of a healthy collection
